strategies.text:
Overview

Mega Raichu Y is an excellent addition to Electric themed battle parties with its ability to DPS in small windows and potential power in Zap Cannon+. Due to its very fragile and mostly non-threatening movesets this solo is quite simple.

Est Time to Win: 170.5s - 210.5s

Main Strategy

Utilizing Primal Groudon, comfortably DPS Mega Raichu per cycle until Primal Groudon requires healing. Be mindful to exit the fight without having leftover energy as this would lower DPS significantly if repeated too often.


Mega Raichu Y has 1 counter point to Primal Groudon in learning Surf. As a result if it learns Surf, it is recommended to add additional ground attackers. Lots of damage & energy will be absorbed from surf so it is wise to not over extend using each attacker. A recommended strategy is swapping to the next attacker when below 25-30% health.

Overview

Mega Raichu Y's frailty makes it much easier to beat compared to its X counterpart. Conveniently so, Mega Raichu Y is better in terms of an Attacker than X. So as expected for an Electric Raid Boss, you'll want a strong Ground attacker.

And what better Ground attacker than Garchomp? With its Ground/Dragon typing giving strong defense and its really good Attack giving strong offense, it's the perfect counter. You don't even need to Mega Evolve it or XL it.

Gible Community Day is also coming soon, and with it a perfect opportunity to get a Garchomp and start walloping these recharging rats.

Est Time to Win

290-300 seconds

Main Strategy

Recycle, recycle, recycle, and you guessed it; recycle. Also be sure to relobby before your Pokémon faints so you can save time and Revives from the relobby.
